summary: Feed s128_double is degraded: 2 faults found. VLAN 20 missing (50% untagged, high severity) and encrypted share 94.7% exceeds NDR 90% tolerance (medium). No duplicates, packet drops, tool overload, or one-way traffic issues.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN/TAP trunk is stripping 802.1Q tags or not forwarding VLAN 20 tagged. 50% of packets arrive untagged and VLAN 20 is never observed, despite NDR requiring VLANs 10 and 20.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR loses VLAN-aware segmentation and correlation for VLAN 20; cannot apply VLAN-specific detection policies and misses lateral movement or policy violations confined to VLAN 20 - effectively 50% visibility loss.

recommended_fix.why: Preserving/restoring 802.1Q tags on the packet broker ingress/trunk and ensuring VLAN 20 is forwarded tagged restores NDR's required VLAN visibility and segmentation.

findings.root_cause: Traffic mix is ~94.7% encrypted (TLS), exceeding the NDR's 90% tolerance. NDR needs full payload but receives opaque encrypted payloads with no upstream decryption.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR cannot perform deep packet inspection, signature matching, or payload analytics on encrypted flows; detection degrades to metadata/flow analysis only, increasing false negatives for payload-based threats.

recommended_fix.why: Decrypting relevant TLS (or providing a decrypted copy) upstream of the NDR restores full-payload inspection capability that this NDR requires, bringing encrypted share back within tolerance.
